name: SiteHeader
title: SiteHeader
summary: The site-wide black header bar for ism.bible: ISM mark, five main links (three open submenus), a white Give pill and a menu button that opens the mobile drawer.
whenToUse: Use it once, at the top of every ism.bible page and every page built from the website kit.
whenNotToUse: Do not use it inside apps (dot.Bible app screens have their own top bar) or in email.
Do not add a second header for a section. Section navigation belongs in Tabs or AnchorNav under the hero.

anatomy.description: Two parts: the bar (`header.hdr`) and the drawer (`.drawer` with `.drawer-scrim`). The bar is fixed, 72px tall, `var(--black)`.
anatomy.markup: Current main links, in order: About ISM ⌄, Resources ⌄, Global Network, Join The Mission ⌄, Contact. "Download App" was removed from the bar; the app lives under Resources.

props.name: navigation
props.description: Main navigation, in order. Keep to five items; put new pages in a submenu.

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
Component used to render every internal link. Defaults to `'a'`.
Pass `next/link` (or any component that accepts `href`, `className`, `onClick` and `children`)
so client-side routing works.

props.name: logo
props.description: Logo slot for the bar. Defaults to an `` using `logoSrc`. The CSS inverts black artwork to white.

props.name: drawerLogo
props.description: Logo slot for the top of the drawer. Defaults to a decorative `` using `logoSrc`.

props.name: logoSrc
props.description: Path of the default logo image.

props.name: logoAlt
props.description: Alt text of the default bar logo image.

props.name: logoHref
props.description: Where the logo links to.

props.name: logoLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the logo link.

props.name: give
props.description: Slot for the Give button. Use a white pill: `<a className="btn btn-light btn-sm nv-give" href="/give">`. It is the only button in the bar.

props.name: languageSwitcher
props.description: Slot placed before Give, for example a `LanguageSwitcher`.

props.name: drawerActions
props.description: Slot for the drawer call-to-action area (`.nv-dcta`): "Give online" (`btn-primary btn-lg`) and "Partner with us" (`btn-outline-light btn-lg`).

props.name: skipLabel
props.description: Text of the skip link. When omitted no skip link is rendered; render your own as the first focusable element.

props.name: skipHref
props.description: Target of the skip link.

props.name: navLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the main `<nav>`.

props.name: openMenuLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the menu button.

props.name: closeMenuLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the drawer close button.

props.name: drawerLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the drawer dialog.

props.name: drawerOpen
props.description: Controlled open state of the mobile drawer.

props.name: defaultDrawerOpen
props.description: Initial open state of the drawer when uncontrolled.

props.name: onDrawerOpenChange
props.description: Called when the drawer wants to open or close.

react.notes: `import { SiteHeader } from '@ism/ui'` (source: `packages/react/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx`). Data-driven: it renders the bar and drawer markup below from `navigation`, and handles the behaviour in Accessibility: submenus open on click and mouse hover and close on Esc (focus returns to the caret button) and outside click. The drawer traps focus, closes on Esc and scrim click, locks body scroll and returns focus to the menu button. `.is-scrolled` is added automatically past 8px. Only `navigation` is required. Give, the drawer buttons and the skip link are not built in; pass them as props.

variantNotes: **Top of page:** `.hdr` with a transparent bottom border.
**Scrolled (>8px):** add `.is-scrolled` for the shadow and white hairline.
**Current section:** `aria-current="page"` on the link or caret button shows the gradient underline.
**Submenu open:** caret button `aria-expanded="true"`, caret rotates 180°, `.nv-subpanel` drops 14px below the bar. Row hover is `rgba(255,255,255,.07)`.
**Below 1024px:** `.ism-desk` hides the links; the menu button opens the drawer. Caret rows (`.nv-dparent`) expand in place, one at a time; open row turns `var(--blue-on-dark)`.
**Static preview:** add `.nv-static` to `.hdr` or `.drawer` to drop fixed positioning (docs and boards only).

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Keep the bar `var(--black)` with the white logo (`filter: brightness(0) invert(1)`). Never put the header on white.
Use the icon rule: caret ⌄ = opens a submenu here; ↗ = goes to another page; › = drills into an app screen (never in the website header).
The first row of every submenu links to the section's own page (`.nv-overview`).
Give is the only button in the bar and stays `.btn-light` (white pill). In the drawer, the one Horizon Blue primary is "Give online"; "Partner with us" is `.btn-outline-light`.
Max five main links. Add new pages to a submenu, not to the bar.
Every tap target is at least 44px (`.navlink`, `.iconbtn`, `.nv-dsub a`).

accessibility: Make the skip link the first focusable element.
Caret items are `<button>`s with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`; plain items are links.
Open submenus on click and on hover; close on Esc and on click outside, and return focus to the caret button.
The drawer is `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"`; trap focus inside, close on Esc and scrim click, and return focus to the menu button.
The heart icon is `aria-hidden`; the visible "Give" text is the label.
content: Link labels are short nouns in Title Case: "About ISM", "Join The Mission".
Submenu rows have a title and a one-line description: "dot.Bible App · Free Bible apps in 500+ languages", "HD Radio Broadcast · Scripture on the airwaves".
The Give pill always says "Give". Drawer buttons say "Give online" and "Partner with us".
